summary: This is the output of a first collections program: a Library class stores three book titles in a List<String> and prints each one on its own line with a for loop. The order of the printed lines matches the order in which the titles were added to the list.

lines.text: The first title added to the list is the first one printed, because a List keeps its elements in insertion order.
The second title appears on its own line, since the loop calls println once per element rather than printing the whole list at once.
The last title added is printed last, and the loop then ends because there are no more elements to visit.
